paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the throughput comparison between PyramidInfer and Full Cache under varying batch sizes for the LLaMA 2-7B model. The x-axis represents Batch Size, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10, and no units specified. The y-axis represents Throughput in tokens per second, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2500, marked at intervals of 500. The plot features two lines: one for PyramidInfer, which is pink and solid, and one for Full Cache, which is teal and solid. The PyramidInfer line starts at approximately 50 tokens/s at batch size 0, and increases steadily to about 2600 tokens/s at batch size 70. The Full Cache line starts at approximately 50 tokens/s at batch size 0, rises to around 1300 tokens/s at batch size 30, then declines to about 1000 tokens/s at batch size 70.
